title: ResourceExportCompact
description: A *resource_export* object represents a request to bulk export objects for one or more resources.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

created_at.description: The time at which the resource export object was created.

download_url.description:
Download this URL to retrieve the full export
in [JSON Lines](https://jsonlines.org/) format. It will be compressed in a gzip (.gz) container.

*Note: May be null if the export is still in progress or failed.*

completed_at.description: The time at which this resource was completed. This will be null if the export is still in progress.
